verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API that any OpenAI SDK or client can use by pointing it at localhost:8080. It also supports the Anthropic Messages API, the Open Responses API and OpenAI functions/tools. Beyond inference, a /models/apply endpoint handles model installation and per-user API keys are available, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probes on localai.io all returned 404), documentation of the management/admin endpoints beyond one /models/apply mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
